name: Acid Chrome
tagline: Acid-lime brand reel: heavy all-caps statements, a spinning liquid-chrome knot and hard cuts on every beat.
description: Portfolio and brand-reel style for studios, agencies, launches and sizzle intros. Backgrounds hard-cut between near-black, acid lime and off-white on the beat; each scene states one huge heavy grotesk all-caps line that ends in a period, with the second line in lime (or a black box on lime). A glossy liquid-chrome object (torus knot, ring, figure-eight, puffy lime star) spins and morphs on the right, framed by a thin mono HUD: scene index 01 — 06, section labels, progress dashes, timecode, arrows and a pulsing beat waveform.

display.usage: All-caps statements 186px, line-height 0.9, tracking -0.03em, always ending in a period

body.usage: Uppercase sublines 26px and HUD labels 19px, tracking 0.06–0.08em

transitions: hard cut on the beat with a full background colour swap (black → lime → black → off-white → black → lime)
the chrome element re-pops from scale 0 with a back-out overshoot on every cut
ghost outline copies of the headline word slide past in opposite directions
textAnimations: each line rises out of its own mask (yPercent 105 → 0, 0.42s expo.out, 0.07s stagger)
mono sublines rise 24px and fade in 0.3s after the headline
percentage counter and progress bar tick up under the main element
CTA chip pops with back.out then flips to black with lime text

rhythm.notes: One statement per beat-length shot (~1.25s at 144 BPM); only the end card holds 1.5s. The chrome object never stops rotating and the HUD progress line runs continuously.

guide:
- Look only: build the user's own subject in this visual language; don't reuse the example's scene.
- Cycle full-frame backgrounds near-black #0b0b0a, acid lime #d4ff3a (radial-lit: #e6ff7a centre → #d4ff3a → #b6dc1c edge) and off-white #efeee6 with a hard cut every ~1.25s (one beat at 144 BPM); never crossfade. Lime is the only accent.
- Headlines: Inter Tight 900 uppercase, ~186px (up to 280px for a single word), line-height 0.9, tracking -0.03em, left-aligned at 90px, 2–3 short lines ending in a period. The second line is lime on black, or a black box with lime text on lime; plain black text only on off-white.
- Reveal each line from its own overflow-hidden mask (yPercent 105 → 0, 0.42s expo.out, 0.07s stagger); JetBrains Mono 500 uppercase sublines (26px, tracking 0.06em) rise 24px and fade in 0.3s later.
- One glossy liquid-chrome element per scene, ~460px on the right half: the subject itself or an abstract form that stands for it. Build it in SVG from stacked strokes: a black edge, two chrome gradients (#efeee6 → #8d8e88 → #0e0e0e) that slide over time, a lime reflection band offset down-right and a thin white specular offset up-left. It never stops rotating or drifting (linear), re-pops from scale 0 with back.out(1.4) on every cut and morphs between shapes with power3.out.
- Frame every scene with a JetBrains Mono HUD (19px, uppercase, tracking 0.08em): name top-left with a 10px lime dot, scene index '0N — 0M' top-right, section label under a hairline rule at 18% opacity, a bottom rule with a running 3px lime progress line, progress dashes and a timecode. Add one detail per scene: a diagonal arrow glyph, a pulsing bar waveform or a % counter.
- For emphasis, ghost outline copies of the headline word (transparent fill, 2px stroke at 20% opacity, ~280px) slide past in opposite directions.
- Pacing: one statement per ~1.25s shot; only the last card holds ~1.5s. The HUD progress line runs continuously. Close on lime with a name, a black-box line and a bordered chip that flips to black with lime text.
- Avoid soft gradients behind type, script or serif fonts, crossfades, or a second accent colour.
example: The preview is a studio brand reel: beat-cut statements like 'PRECISE.' beside a spinning chrome torus knot, figure-eight and lime star, ending on a 'Voltwerk' card. Don't copy this scene unless asked.
